description: Scripts injected into the REMOTE arena.ai page (injected/*.js via bridge.js). The dock is its own webview on macOS (WebviewUrl::App dock.html) and embedded inside the page on Android (dock-embedded.gen.js). Deliberately narrow: hand over run tokens, relay page events to the dock, allowlisted proxy GETs, the JSON store and the Rust event stream the embedded dock subscribes to (arenakit://trace, arenakit://page). No window/webview APIs and no arena_command (the page must never eval into itself via Rust).
